changes: The flat map is now a real 3D sandstone garden with three terrace heights, visible stairs on disclosed legal passages, original articulated Pip and Thornback models, keys, gates, traps and an exit portal.
Follow, Detail and Overview cameras, a public-data map, optional original audio, captions, reduced motion, high contrast and clean feed are integrated.

Graphics loss reveals a live map, offers a retry and returns to the current public position after restoration. Real results remain visible in map mode; reconnecting is now explicit during terminal states.
Cumulative steps and discovered area reflect the public snapshot. Character feet, route marks, lights and camera targets follow the same stair heights.

Pip now has a coral scarf and bedroll, clearer eyes and directional gaze; Thornback has a broader bronze face and brighter eyes. Fresh actual portrait, desktop, detail and encounter captures are recorded.

Keys have a thicker silhouette and readable sway; the exit has a mint opening and diamond crown. Quieter trim, grouped planting and shoreline contacts are implemented. The mobile critic still wants stronger objective contrast and clearer local intent.

Map and Path notes expand on demand, while the goal and immediate intent stay visible. Natural captions replace internal object IDs, and the camera label says Detail. Browser checks verify disclosure drawing, Escape/focus and terminal reconnect; a fresh blind critic preferred the compact mobile layout.

A fifth-pass encounter-staging candidate now gives Pip threat-directed head, gaze and lantern poses, and Thornback anticipatory mask/mandible poses, using only disclosed nearby threats. Fresh render and independent critique are still pending.

Sixth pass: real production snapshots now select an actually close, already-disclosed Thornback/Pip encounter; actual browser evidence records both actors on screen, source/image SHA-256 hashes and seed/tick. An amplified public-threat-only head/gaze/lantern/mask response is tested without changing deterministic game authority.

Seventh pass: two original model-level silhouette cues now make nearby already-disclosed guardian encounters clearer, using Pip's gold/coral exclamation signal and Thornback's raised glowing spines. Real current-source CI captures prove both actors share the frame; terminal and undisclosed-threat states suppress the cues without changing AI/game authority.

Eighth pass: a reuse-only pool of in-world ivory direction arrows marks genuinely known, reciprocally legal neighboring corridors; teal is reserved for a current disclosed AI-plan step. Closed gate edges and stale/nonreciprocal plans are suppressed, while the misleading gold threat halo is now a triangular warning signal. This changes only presentation; current-source CI and authentic dated evidence were captured.

Ninth and tenth passes: a known, connected public key/exit now gets a distinctive in-world beacon and a separate first-step floor arrow (amber for key, mint for exit), while turquoise continues to denote only the disclosed AI plan. Tests exclude closed gates, blocked/nonreciprocal/unknown cells, hidden goals and terminal states. One native 1280×900 current-source image authenticates the known exit cue; visual bar remains unpassed.

Eleventh pass: a known exit's modeled arch is no longer crowded by a redundant hovering beacon; its low ground marker and truthful first-step glyph remain. Nearby already-observed objectives receive closer follow framing without altering AI state. Real dated 1280×900 evidence shows a larger Pip but also a less balanced water/stage composition, now the next visual gap.

Twelfth pass: the follow camera now keeps some nearby disclosed stage context while still pointing toward an already observed reachable landmark, with a single 2.5-world-unit cap when the goal is close. Original 3D geometry, public-only route semantics, character expressions and deterministic rules remain unchanged; browser evidence is pending.

Thirteenth pass: disclosed closed doors gain original coral crossed physical barriers and larger lock plates while opened/undisclosed doors render no warning obstruction. Public-knowledge tests and real key/sealed-gate camera evidence were added; four genuine same-seed screenshots have dated verified SHA-256 manifests in GitHub CI artifact 13030701894. This is not benchmark parity.

Fourteenth pass: the original disclosed closed gate's coral crossed brace and gold lock now sit on the camera-facing side of its physical bars, for both door orientations; open or undisclosed barriers remain absent. Exact-source CI passed 523 Node and 25 browser checks. Real same-seed/tick21 1280×900 screenshot at 2026-10-31T05:04:37.546Z (SHA256 3ef0814c04f38a2465687b7feded50c6d8b7dc24c3da6ed2278de74f356ef668) shows the X clearly but gate is small at the far left and Pip partly obscured. Nintendo remains stronger; no independent critic or GPU performance claim.
nextGaps: The pass-fourteen crossed seal and lock now face the camera, but the actual public closed gate is still small at the left edge and partly obscures Pip. Improve authentic gate/Pip joint composition without suggesting locked or undisclosed corridors are open, then examine native-size real output.
Capture and inspect actual narrow portrait key and closed-gate frames with Pip legible and all controls accessible; do not infer screenshot quality from DOM tests alone.
Increase character-at-gameplay-scale expression, exit/obstacle differentiation and level-specific architecture while maintaining the original 3D characters.
Obtain fresh independent blind A/B from native-size real gameplay against both SHA-pinned official Nintendo references; no parity verdict yet.
Verify moving stair/gait and audio behavior plus non-throttled GPU performance separately; SwiftShader CPU timing is not hardware FPS. Leave PR draft, unmerged and undeployed.
